name: CT Hybrid Search API
description: REST/manual hybrid search over CT indicator events. Combines BM25 keyword search with semantic search on indicator_message_semantic using RRF. Prefer the Elasticsearch Search Application endpoint for sync results: POST /_application/search_application/ct-hybrid-search-api/_search
